title: fix(cli): an os migrate audit-* run stops when a registered host signer or sink fails to resolve
body:
<!-- claude-projects-attribution: {"github_login":"os-steve"} -->
_Requested by **Steve** · [project thread](https://claude.ai/code/project/chan_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi9?thread=cmsg_01FdL1XeUyvVNxLreh3F4Qi96xkbCcbB1nF3xM9vBtrWwE)_

Fixes #34519

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## 维护者速读

- **改了什么：** `os migrate audit-*` 四个改写命令在改写已封存的行之前要先签一份修订；签名时取宿主的签名服务和导出服务。现在和封存器（#34280）一样分三种情况：没注册就用本机钥（不变）；注册了能取到就用；注册了却取不到就整次运行报错退出，不改任何行。
- **为什么改：** 以前「取不到」被当成「没注册」，修订会悄悄改用本机钥签名，导出也悄悄丢掉；工厂方式注册的签名器也取不到。这和 #34280 修掉的封存器问题同一形状。
- **风险与回滚：** 只影响注册了签名器或导出服务、且注册已经坏掉的宿主：从悄悄降级变成报错退出（exit 1）。配置正常的宿主无变化。回滚即还原本 PR。
- **先看：** `packages/cli/src/utils/audit-redaction-seal.ts` 末尾的 `hostSeam`；四个命令里 `await redaction.seal(...)` 一行。
- **两分钟验证：** `cd packages/cli && npx vitest run src/utils/audit-redaction-seal.host-seam-34519.test.ts`，预期 4 条全绿。
- **需要你做的：** 无，席位落地。

## What changes

- `packages/cli/src/utils/audit-redaction-seal.ts`: `RedactionSealRun.seal()` is now async and resolves `audit.checkpointSigner` and `audit.checkpointSink` through `hostSeam()`: the kernel's `getServiceAsync`, absorbing only the branded "never registered" rejection (`isServiceNotRegisteredError`, `@objectstack/core`); every other rejection becomes `Audit redaction seal: the '<slot>' service is registered but could not be resolved (<cause>) — no sealed row is amended or rewritten; the run does not <fallback> in place of a service the host registered. …`, with the cause attached. A kernel with no async accessor keeps the sync read, where "not registered" is the only fault. This is the rule and the wording of PR #34495 (the sealer, #34280).
- The four commands (`audit-key-material`, `audit-mail-bodies`, `audit-metadata-bodies`, `audit-side-copies`): `const seal = await redaction.seal(stack.kernel, engine);`. The call already sat inside the try whose catch prints the error (or the `--json` error object) and exits 1, before `underAuditSealLock`, so a rejection stops the run before any row is amended or rewritten.
- `content/docs/deployment/cli.mdx` (Sealed audit rows): one paragraph says who signs the amendments (the host signer when registered, the local key when none) and that a signer or sink registered but not resolvable stops the run with exit 1, never falling back to the local key.

## Tests

- New `src/utils/audit-redaction-seal.host-seam-34519.test.ts` (real `ObjectKernel` service registry; the crypto composition is stubbed to "no provider", which a run survives):
  1. nothing registered: `signer` and `sink` are `undefined`, so the amendment writer signs with the local key, as before;
  2. a signer factory that throws: `seal()` rejects with the slot name, the cause and "does not sign with the local key";
  3. a sink factory that throws: `seal()` rejects naming `audit.checkpointSink`;
  4. a signer that resolves, as an instance and as a factory, is handed over.
- `audit-redaction-seal.contract.test.ts`: one new pin per command: `seal()` is awaited exactly once, before the `underAuditSealLock(` hold.
- Ablation (fix reverted, tests kept): 7 red (cases 2–4 and the four await pins), case 1 green.
- The new test imports `@objectstack/service-settings` at module top, as `check:test-source-alias` asks (the util's static reach names it through the mocked `one-shot-settings.js`).
- No existing assertion changed. `packages/cli`: `pnpm typecheck` (incl. `check:test-typecheck`) green; `src/commands/migrate/` + the new file: 75 files, 606 passed / 8 skipped.

## Acceptance notes

- The card names the signer; the sink rides the same helper and the same rule, as in PR #34495, so it is covered here too.
- `Clause-②: no`: no key, flag or config value an operator writes is refused; a run on a host whose signer or sink registration already fails now exits 1 instead of amending under the local key.

## Verification

Gates per `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --commands` after the last commit: see the `os-dev-report` comment on #34519.
